items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: That's when we got Peanuts too.

ctx.x: I remember something-- Red used to go out and jam, I guess you probably did, and some local cat blew him out--Billy Douglas was around here for quite a while.
Red got to be a hellion
later, but Red was playing allright, but he didn't play no great music with that band. I didn't like his playing.
